title: FarmLand Product Schedule — Homesite Acreage Addition to the Release Premium (Farm Real Estate Loans)
content:
A larger homesite carries a higher release premium percentage when it is split out of a Farm Real Estate Loans mortgage. The homesite addition follows its deeded acres: 10 acres or more adds 10.0 points; 5 acres or more but less than 10 adds 5.0 points; a smaller homesite adds none.

**What the records show.** The deeded acres on the mortgage record of the homesite — the parcel of land use farmstead still mortgaged to the loan.

| Homesite deeded acres | Addition to the release premium percentage |
|---|---|
| 10 or more | 10.0 points |
| 5 or more, less than 10 | 5.0 points |
| less than 5 | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical homesites)

| Deeded acres | Addition |
|---|---|
| 4.99 | none |
| 5.00 | 5.0 points |
| 9.99 | 5.0 points |
| 10.00 | 10.0 points |
| 17.5 | 10.0 points |
